check_description: season_year must be present because it is the structural identifier of the season.
Primary key ['season_year'] must be unique among complete key values.
season_year must be compatible with the Formula 1 historical domain, starting from 1950.
number_of_events must be greater than zero when present.
season_start_date must be before season_end_date when both are present.
The year component of season dates must be coherent with season_year.
team_id and team_name must be present.
Primary key ['team_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
team_url must have a valid URL format when present.
grand_prix_id, season_year, round_number, event_name, event_format, and circuit_id must be present.
Primary key ['grand_prix_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
Natural key ['season_year', 'round_number'] should be unique among complete key values.
round_number must be greater than zero.
event_format must belong to the allowed Grand Prix event format domain.
event_date must be coherent with season_year when present.
grand_prix.season_year must reference season.season_year.
grand_prix.circuit_id must reference circuit.circuit_id.
session_id, grand_prix_id, and session_type must be present.
Primary key ['session_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
Natural key ['grand_prix_id', 'session_type'] should be unique among complete key values.
session_type must belong to the allowed session domain for this project: Q or R.
session_date should be coherent with the corresponding Grand Prix event_date. For Q and R sessions, it should normally fall between event_date minus two days and event_date.
session.grand_prix_id must reference grand_prix.grand_prix_id.
result_id, session_id, driver_id, and team_id must be present.
Primary key ['result_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
Natural key ['session_id', 'driver_id'] should be unique among complete key values.
position must be greater than zero when present.
points must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
laps must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
grid_position must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
result.session_id must reference session.session_id.
result.driver_id must reference driver.driver_id.
result.team_id must reference team.team_id.
Structural lap identifiers and timeline attribute must be present.
Primary key ['lap_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
Natural key ['session_id', 'driver_id', 'lap_number'] should be unique among complete key values.
lap_number must be greater than zero.
lap_time_ms must be positive when present.
Sector times must be positive when present.
Speed attributes must be positive when present.
stint must be positive when present.
tyre_life must be positive when present.
compound must belong to the expected tyre compound domain when present.
For timed laps with complete sector information, the sum of sector times should be coherent with lap_time_ms.
lap.session_id must reference session.session_id.
lap.driver_id must reference driver.driver_id.
lap.team_id must reference team.team_id.
Weather identifier, session timeline, and main weather measures must be present.
Primary key ['weather_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
Natural key ['session_id', 'time_ms'] should be unique among complete key values.
time_ms must be greater than or equal to zero.
air_temp must be within a broad Formula 1 weather domain range when present.
track_temp must be within a broad Formula 1 track temperature domain range when present.
humidity must be between 0 and 100 when present.
pressure must be within a broad realistic atmospheric range when present.
wind_direction must be a degree value between 0 and 360 when present.
wind_speed must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
track_temp should be reasonably coherent with air_temp.
weather.session_id must reference session.session_id.
Track status identifier, session timeline, status, and message must be present.
Primary key ['track_status_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
Natural key ['session_id', 'time_ms'] should be unique among complete key values.
time_ms must be greater than or equal to zero.
status must belong to the documented track status code domain.
message must belong to the documented track status message domain.
The numerical status code must correspond to the expected textual message.
track_status.session_id must reference session.session_id.
Circuit identifier and analytical classification columns must be present.
Primary key ['circuit_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
global_circuit_category must belong to the allowed global circuit category domain.
sector1_category must belong to the allowed sector category domain.
sector2_category must belong to the allowed sector category domain.
sector3_category must belong to the allowed sector category domain.
driver_id, abbreviation, and last_name must be present.
Primary key ['driver_id'] must be unique among complete key values.
abbreviation must be a three-letter uppercase driver code.
driver_url must have a valid URL format when present.
permanent_number must be between 1 and 99 when present.
Driver age during the selected 2021--2022 seasons should be within a broad plausible Formula 1 range.
